# Agent Role Definition Sheet

Use one sheet per specialist (human or bot) that sits on your personal Round Table.

| Field | Entry |
|-------|--------|
| **Callsign** | |
| **Primary question it answers** | |
| **Data sources / evidence it is allowed to use** | |
| **Failure modes** (when it is most likely wrong) | |
| **Horizon it is trusted for** | |
| **How rank is earned or lost** | |
| **Listen factor today** (high / medium / muted) | |

Keep the roster small (4–6 seats). Rank by recent usefulness, not by title. When two seats chronically conflict, force a confluence rule or default to Wait.
